name: rsi_connors_pullback_v54
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On BANKNIFTY, banking-sector institutional order flow executes in 90-120 second directional bursts driven by TWAP/VWAP algos rebalancing large banking equity and futures baskets. Within each burst, there are systematic 20-30 second micro-pauses — visible as RSI(6) (30-second RSI) retracing toward 45 while RSI(24) (2-minute RSI) still reflects the prevailing burst direction above 55. The original Strategy_110 logic (any dip when RSI(2) < 50 above SMA(200)) translates here as: RSI(6) < 45 is the 'any dip' in BANKNIFTY's fast cycle, while RSI(24) > 55 confirms the 2-min burst momentum is intact. Unlike prior variants using SMA or VWAP price-level filters, this dual-RSI approach is purely momentum-state driven — exploiting BANKNIFTY's higher beta (1.3-1.5x NIFTY) which produces more distinguishable RSI oscillations at 30-second resolution, enabling re-entry into the burst within 15-45 seconds of the micro-pause.

indicators.name: rsi_24
indicators.purpose: 24 bars × 5s = 120 seconds = 2-minute RSI as the momentum-burst direction filter. Original SMA(200) at 5-min was a slow structural filter (1000+ minutes lookback). For BANKNIFTY at 5s, a 2-minute RSI window captures one full institutional TWAP burst cycle without lagging 10-15 minutes like SMA(180). RSI(24) > 55 means BANKNIFTY has been predominantly rising over the last 2 minutes — the burst is active. NOT scaled from original 200-period (that would be 1000 bars = 83 min, far too slow). Instead, period chosen to match BANKNIFTY's characteristic institutional burst duration of 90-120 seconds.

indicators.name: rsi_6
indicators.purpose: 6 bars × 5s = 30-second RSI as the micro-pullback entry trigger. Original RSI(2) at 5-min = 10-minute sensitivity. At 5s bars, RSI(2) = 10 seconds — pure tick noise. RSI(6) at 30 seconds is the minimum viable RSI lookback on BANKNIFTY where price action reflects a genuine micro-direction shift rather than a single large tick. BANKNIFTY's higher volatility vs NIFTY makes RSI(6) reliable where RSI(6) on NIFTY would still be noisy — BANKNIFTY moves 3-4x more per 30s than NIFTY. The threshold RSI(6) < 45 matches the original's RSI(2) < 50 logic: 'cooled off but not extreme' — a pullback entry, not an oversold reversal.

conditions: rsi_24 > rsi_trend_threshold (default 55.0) — 2-min momentum burst is bullish
rsi_6 < rsi_entry_low (default 45.0) — 30s micro-pullback within the bull burst
warmed_up: at least 26 bars elapsed (RSI(24) needs 24 bars + 2 initialization bars)
buy_ce.confirmation: Both RSI conditions met simultaneously — not sequentially; entry fires at the bar where short RSI dips while medium RSI confirms the burst direction

conditions: rsi_24 < (100 - rsi_trend_threshold) (default 45.0) — 2-min momentum burst is bearish
rsi_6 > (100 - rsi_entry_low) (default 55.0) — 30s micro-bounce within the bear burst
buy_pe.confirmation: Symmetric to buy_ce; RSI(24) < 45 confirms downward burst, RSI(6) > 55 detects micro-bounce exhaustion

exit.stop_rationale: 5 option pts = ~10 BANKNIFTY spot pts at delta 0.5. BANKNIFTY 30-second typical move is 3-7 option pts. A 5-pt stop allows normal micro-fluctuations within the burst but exits if BANKNIFTY reverses 10 spot pts against the RSI(24) burst direction — at which point the 2-min momentum has genuinely reversed, not just paused. Wider than NIFTY counterparts (v49 uses 4 pts) because BANKNIFTY's higher volatility requires proportionally more room to avoid stop-hunting on legitimate bursts.
exit.target_rationale: 8 option pts = ~16 BANKNIFTY spot pts at delta 0.5. BANKNIFTY micro-burst resumptions after a 30-second RSI(6) pullback within active 2-min momentum typically cover 15-25 spot pts within 30-90 seconds (7-12 option pts). Targeting 8 pts captures the lower-median continuation, achieving 1:1.6 R:R while exiting before the next natural micro-pause in the institutional burst cycle.

filters.vix_filter: none — VIX not used; dual-RSI provides self-contained regime signal within the bar
filters.time_filter: 09:20-15:25 IST; skip pre-open noise and final 5 minutes
filters.volume_filter: none — BANKNIFTY index volume too noisy at 5s resolution
filters.trend_filter: RSI(24) > 55 / < 45 serves as the intraday momentum-state filter
filters.spread_filter: none — limit order execution, no spread cost

edge.edge_decay_risk: medium — Connors RSI pullback concept is widely known; alpha depends on BANKNIFTY's structural burst-pause cycle remaining stable. If banking-sector flow becomes more continuous (less bursty), RSI(6) pullbacks will be shallower and harder to exploit.

adaptation_notes: Strategy_110 is essentially Strategy_108/109 with slightly different RSI thresholds (RSI(2) < 50 vs < 30, and RSI(2) > 20 for shorts — the long entry is 'any dip' not 'oversold'). Key differentiation from prior variants: (1) BANKNIFTY only — higher beta and burst-cycle dynamics specific to banking-sector TWAP flow, contrasted with v49 (NIFTY + SMA) and v50 (BOTH + VWAP); (2) Dual-RSI filter instead of price-level filter — RSI(24) replaces SMA(180)/VWAP as the trend state detector, enabling faster adaptation to intraday regime shifts; (3) RSI(6) as entry trigger rather than RSI(12) — appropriate for BANKNIFTY's faster oscillation cycle; (4) Thresholds are moderate (55/45), matching original's 'any dip' philosophy (RSI < 50) rather than extreme oversold (v50's RSI < 20). Exit converted from SMA(5) crossover and ATR stop to fixed premium points as required by the options pipeline.
weaknesses: RSI(6) at 5s on BANKNIFTY will fire many signals in choppy markets when RSI(24) is near 50 — the 55/45 RSI(24) thresholds may still allow noisy entries when 2-min momentum is borderline
Dual-RSI approach has no price-level anchor (no VWAP, no SMA) — in strong trending sessions the strategy may re-enter repeatedly at progressively worse levels as RSI(24) stays elevated
BANKNIFTY's higher volatility means 5-pt option stop may still trigger on legitimate bursts during high-VIX sessions
No session-time weighting — opening 30-min and closing 30-min BANKNIFTY dynamics differ from mid-session, but the strategy treats all session times equally
